name: tsum_sq_fourierCoeff
result.signature: (f : Lp ℂ 2 <| @haarAddCircle T hT) : ∑' i : ℤ, ‖fourierCoeff f i‖ ^ 2 = ∫ t : AddCircle T, ‖f t‖ ^ 2 ∂haarAddCircle
result.type:
∀ {T : ℝ} [hT : Fact (0 < T)] (f : ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 2 AddCircle.haarAddCircle)),
  ∑' (i : ℤ), ‖fourierCoeff (↑↑f) i‖ ^ 2 = ∫ (t : AddCircle T), ‖↑↑f t‖ ^ 2 ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle
result.informal_name: Parseval's Identity for Fourier Series on the Additive Circle
result.informal_description: For any function $ f $ in the $ L^2 $ space on the additive circle $ \mathbb{R}/(T\mathbb{Z}) $ with respect to the Haar measure $ \mu $, the sum of the squares of the norms of its Fourier coefficients equals the integral of the square of the norm of $ f $. Specifically, $ \sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} \|\hat{f}(n)\|^2 = \int_{t \in \mathbb{R}/(T\mathbb{Z})} \|f(t)\|^2 \, d\mu(t) $, where $ \hat{f}(n) $ denotes the $ n $-th Fourier coefficient of $ f $.

name: UnitAddTorus
hasSum_sq_mFourierCoeff
result.signature: (f : L²(UnitAddTorus d)) : HasSum (fun i ↦ ‖mFourierCoeff f i‖ ^ 2) (∫ t, ‖f t‖ ^ 2)
result.type:
∀ {d : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype d] (f : ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 2 MeasureTheory.volume)),
  HasSum (fun i => ‖UnitAddTorus.mFourierCoeff (↑↑f) i‖ ^ 2) (∫ (t : UnitAddTorus d), ‖↑↑f t‖ ^ 2)
result.value:
:= by
  simpa only [← RCLike.inner_apply', inner_self_eq_norm_sq, ← integral_re (L2.integrable_inner f f)] using
    RCLike.hasSum_re ℂ (hasSum_prod_mFourierCoeff f f)
result.informal_name: Parseval's Identity for Fourier Coefficients on the Additive Torus
result.informal_description: For any square-integrable function $f$ on the $d$-dimensional additive torus $\mathbb{R}^d/\mathbb{Z}^d$, the sum of the squares of the norms of its Fourier coefficients converges to the integral of the squared norm of $f$ over the torus, i.e., $\sum_{i} \|\hat{f}(i)\|^2 = \int_{\mathbb{R}^d/\mathbb{Z}^d} \|f(t)\|^2 \, dt$.

name: hasSum_sq_fourierCoeff
result.signature:
(f : Lp ℂ 2 <| @haarAddCircle T hT) :
  HasSum (fun i => ‖fourierCoeff f i‖ ^ 2) (∫ t : AddCircle T, ‖f t‖ ^ 2 ∂haarAddCircle)
result.type:
∀ {T : ℝ} [hT : Fact (0 < T)] (f : ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 2 AddCircle.haarAddCircle)),
  HasSum (fun i => ‖fourierCoeff (↑↑f) i‖ ^ 2) (∫ (t : AddCircle T), ‖↑↑f t‖ ^ 2 ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle)
result.value:
:= by
  simp_rw [← fourierBasis_repr]
  have H₁ : HasSum (fun i => ‖fourierBasis.repr f i‖ ^ 2) (‖fourierBasis.repr f‖ ^ 2) :=
    by
    apply_mod_cast lp.hasSum_norm ?_ (fourierBasis.repr f)
    simp
  have H₂ : ‖fourierBasis.repr f‖ ^ 2 = ‖f‖ ^ 2 := by simp
  have H₃ := congr_arg RCLike.re (@L2.inner_def (AddCircle T) ℂ ℂ _ _ _ _ _ f f)
  rw [← integral_re] at H₃
  · simp only [← norm_sq_eq_re_inner] at H₃
    rwa [H₂, H₃] at H₁
  · exact L2.integrable_inner f f
result.informal_name: Parseval's Identity for Fourier Coefficients on the Additive Circle
result.informal_description: For any function $ f $ in the $ L^2 $ space on the additive circle $ \mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z} $ with respect to the Haar measure $ \mu $, the sum of the squares of the norms of its Fourier coefficients converges to the integral of the square of the norm of $ f $, i.e., $ \sum_{i \in \mathbb{Z}} \|\widehat{f}(i)\|^2 = \int_{t \in \mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z}} \|f(t)\|^2 \, d\mu(t) $.

name: UnitAddTorus
hasSum_prod_mFourierCoeff
result.signature: (f g : L²(UnitAddTorus d)) : HasSum (fun i ↦ conj (mFourierCoeff f i) * (mFourierCoeff g i)) (∫ t, conj (f t) * g t)
result.type:
∀ {d : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype d] (f g : ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 2 MeasureTheory.volume)),
  HasSum (fun i => (starRingEnd ℂ) (UnitAddTorus.mFourierCoeff (↑↑f) i) * UnitAddTorus.mFourierCoeff (↑↑g) i)
    (∫ (t : UnitAddTorus d), (starRingEnd ℂ) (↑↑f t) * ↑↑g t)
result.value:
:= by
  simp_rw [mul_comm (conj _)]
  refine HasSum.congr_fun (mFourierBasis.hasSum_inner_mul_inner f g) (fun n ↦ ?_)
  simp only [← mFourierBasis_repr, HilbertBasis.repr_apply_apply, inner_conj_symm, mul_comm (inner ℂ f _)]
result.informal_name: Parseval's Identity for Fourier Coefficients on the Additive Torus
result.informal_description: For any square-integrable functions $f, g$ on the $d$-dimensional additive torus $\mathbb{R}^d/\mathbb{Z}^d$, the sum over all indices $i$ of the product of the complex conjugate of the $i$-th Fourier coefficient of $f$ and the $i$-th Fourier coefficient of $g$ converges to the inner product $\int_{\mathbb{R}^d/\mathbb{Z}^d} \overline{f(t)} g(t) \, dt$.

name: Finset
addConvolution
result.signature: {G : Type u_1} → [AddGroup G] → [DecidableEq G] → Finset G → Finset G → G → ℕ
result.type: {G : Type u_1} → [AddGroup G] → [DecidableEq G] → Finset G → Finset G → G → ℕ
result.informal_description: For an additive group $G$ with decidable equality, and finite subsets $A, B \subseteq G$, this function returns the number of ordered pairs $(a, b) \in A \times B$ such that $a + b = g$ for a given element $g \in G$. It represents the convolution of the characteristic functions of $A$ and $B$ evaluated at $g$.
